title: Total sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount.

title: Total cost
task: Write a measure for total CostAmount.

title: Total quantity
task: Write a measure summing the Quantity column.

title: Number of sales
context: How many rows in the fact table?
task: Write a measure that counts the rows of Sales.

title: Average quantity
task: Write a measure for the average of Quantity.

title: Average sale amount
task: Write a measure for the average SalesAmount.

title: Largest single sale
task: Write a measure for the maximum SalesAmount.

title: Smallest sale
task: Write a measure for the minimum SalesAmount.

title: Distinct customers
task: Write a measure counting distinct CustomerKey in Sales.

title: Distinct products sold
task: Write a measure counting distinct ProductKey in Sales.

title: Gross profit
task: Write a measure equal to total SalesAmount minus total CostAmount.

title: Average revenue per sale
task: Write a measure = total SalesAmount divided by the row count of Sales, using DIVIDE.

title: Profit margin
task: Write a measure = (SalesAmount − CostAmount) / SalesAmount using DIVIDE.
hint: DIVIDE of the difference over sales.

title: Count of quantity values
task: Write a measure using COUNT on the Quantity column.

title: Electronics sales
context: Filter the total to one category.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Product category is 'Electronics', using CALCULATE.

title: Furniture sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where category is 'Furniture'.

title: North region sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Customer region is 'North'.

title: Corporate segment sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Customer segment is 'Corporate'.

title: Sales in 2024
context: Filter by year from the Date table.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Date year is 2024.

title: Sales in 2023
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where Date year is 2023.

title: Sales size label
task: Write a measure returning 'Big' when total SalesAmount > 500000, else 'Small'.

title: Electronics product count
context: Count rows of a filtered table.
task: Write a measure counting products whose category is 'Electronics' using COUNTROWS and FILTER.

title: Revenue via SUMX
task: Write a measure using SUMX over Sales of Quantity × RELATED(Product[Price]) × (1 − Discount).

title: List price revenue
task: Write a measure using SUMX over Sales of Quantity × RELATED(Product[Price]).

title: Cost check with SUMX
task: Write a measure using SUMX over Sales of Quantity × RELATED(Product[Cost]).

title: Average product markup
task: Write a measure using AVERAGEX over Product of Price − Cost.

title: Priciest product
task: Write a measure using MAXX over Product of Price.

title: Discounted sales count
task: Write a measure counting Sales rows where Discount > 0, using COUNTROWS and FILTER.
